commentary.text: 90+7' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.

90+3' Micky van de Ven (Tottenham) holds his head in his hands after wasting a promising chance. He latches onto a rebound, creates some space for himself and fires the ball from the edge of the box into the stands. The ball goes out of play and Newcastle will have a goal kick.
90+3' Dominic Solanke (Tottenham) connects with a precise cross inside the goalmouth and shoots. One of the defending players reacts in time and clears the ball to safety.
90+1' Eddie Howe has decided to make a change. Lewis Hall (Newcastle Utd) replaces Bruno Guimaraes.
90' There will be a minimum of 6 min. of added time.
89' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd) was quite harsh and Anthony Taylor didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
88' The manager makes a subsitution with Nick Woltemade (Newcastle Utd) coming on for Joe Willock.
88' Eddie Howe prepares a substitution. Anthony Gordon is replaced by William Osula (Newcastle Utd).
81' Radu Dragusin (Tottenham) jumps for a header from the resulting corner kick and sends the ball in on goal, but the goalkeeper makes a very good save.
81' Xavi Simons (Tottenham) will deliver the corner kick.
75' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Jacob Ramsey departs the field of play to be replaced by Sandro Tonali (Newcastle Utd).
75' Eddie Howe has decided to substitute Anthony Elanga and he is replaced by Jacob Murphy (Newcastle Utd).
70' Conor Gallagher goes off the pitch and Randal Kolo Muani (Tottenham) comes on.
68' 1 - 2 Goal! Jacob Ramsey (Newcastle Utd) finds himself some space inside the box to get on the end of a pass from Anthony Gordon, then sends the ball into the bottom right corner. 1:2.
67' Xavi Simons (Tottenham) goes into the book and receives a yellow card. Xavi Simons (Tottenham) dived to the ground without any contact with the opponent.
67' Harvey Barnes (Newcastle Utd) is first to the rebound but his shot is blocked. Wow, what an escape there for the opposition.
67' Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.
64' 1 - 1 GOAL - 1:1! The corner comes over and Pape Matar Sarr flicks on with his head to Archie Gray (Tottenham), who makes no mistake and fires the ball into the back of the net.
64' Xavi Simons (Tottenham) is about to take a corner kick.

63' Conor Gallagher (Tottenham) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Tottenham.
62' Anthony Taylor shows a yellow card to Djed Spence (Tottenham) for his blatant foul.
60' Radu Dragusin (Tottenham) receives the ball inside the box from the resulting free kick, but fails to score as his shot is blocked by one of the defenders.
59' Dan Burn (Newcastle Utd) has tested the patience of referee Anthony Taylor and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
58' Pape Matar Sarr (Tottenham) brings his opponent down. Anthony Taylor has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul. Newcastle will take a free kick near the side line.
57' Joe Willock (Newcastle Utd) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle. Tottenham earn a free kick.
55' The linesman raises his flag. Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) is adjudged offside.
54' Mathys Tel (Tottenham) commits a rough challenge and Anthony Taylor blows his whistle for a foul. Newcastle are awarded the free kick.
52' Conor Gallagher (Tottenham) commits a rough foul. Anthony Taylor stops the game and makes a call. Newcastle have been awarded a free kick.
51' Mathys Tel (Tottenham) receives a well-played pass inside the penalty area and shoots. He sends the ball into orbit. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Newcastle.
50' Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd) gets to the rebound and shoots, but the effort is blocked.
49' The corner is swung in but Newcastle can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
48' The resulting set piece from Newcastle is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Thomas Frank gives a chance to Joao Palhinha and Yves Bissouma (Tottenham) is off.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+8' Anthony Taylor has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.

45+7' Dominic Solanke (Tottenham) collects a great pass inside the box and misses a golden opportunity. His low drive is headed for the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper pulls off a marvellous diving save and denies him.
45+5' 0 - 1 Goal! Malick Thiaw (Newcastle Utd) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low into the middle of the net. It's 0:1.

45+5' Malick Thiaw (Newcastle Utd) rises above the opponent's defence and heads a precise cross towards the middle of the goal. His effort, however, is blocked by Guglielmo Vicario, who pulls off a comfortable save!
45+5' Radu Dragusin (Tottenham) makes a rough challenge and Anthony Taylor blows his whistle for a foul. Newcastle are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
45+2' The referee looks satisfied after his VAR review and duly disallows the goal for offside. The Newcastle players look gutted.
45' We will have 5 min. of added time.
45' The Newcastle players halt their celebrations as referee Anthony Taylor makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.

44' It's in the back of the net! Jacob Ramsey slips the ball through to Joe Willock (Newcastle Utd), and he darts into the box to unleash a magnificent shot into the bottom right corner. He makes it 0:1.
41' Pape Matar Sarr (Tottenham) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.

39' Jacob Ramsey (Newcastle Utd) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Anthony Taylor blows his whistle for an infringement. It's a free kick to Tottenham, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
39' Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. That's a free kick to Tottenham.
38' Newcastle enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.

36' Conor Gallagher (Tottenham) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Anthony Taylor stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning. A free kick is awarded to Newcastle.
35' Wilson Odobert (Tottenham) is substituted due to injury. Thomas Frank gives a chance to Mathys Tel.
31' Wilson Odobert (Tottenham) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
30' Newcastle take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

29' Jacob Ramsey (Newcastle Utd) volleys the ball towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but one of the defenders blocks his shot. The linesman makes the right call and Newcastle will have a corner.
29' Anthony Elanga (Newcastle Utd) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.
24' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Newcastle.
23' Dominic Solanke (Tottenham) is picked out by one of his teammates with a great cross, but his poor control allows the defence to clear and avert the threat.
20' Anthony Elanga (Newcastle Utd) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
18' Anthony Elanga (Newcastle Utd) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.
17' Newcastle can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield. The ball goes out for a corner. Newcastle can continue in their attacking effort.

17' What a goal-scoring opportunity! Jacob Ramsey (Newcastle Utd) finds some space inside the box and fires a volley at goal, but the shot is amazingly blocked by a defender. The linesman points to the corner flag, Newcastle are going to take it.
16' Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd) sends in a poor cross from the corner and Guglielmo Vicario has no trouble gathering it.

15' Harvey Barnes (Newcastle Utd) receives a neat pass inside the box and instantly thumps the ball goalward, but a defender makes a last ditch block to deny him. Newcastle have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
14' Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Guglielmo Vicario intercepts the ball.
11' Guglielmo Vicario pulls off a great save to deny Harvey Barnes (Newcastle Utd) who, makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick low drive towards the middle of the goal.
11' Anthony Elanga (Newcastle Utd) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.

9' Fine attempt! Joe Willock (Newcastle Utd) collects a pass and manages to hold off the defender, then rifles in a shot from mid-range which unluckily swerves inches past the left post. The ball goes out of play and Tottenham will have a goal kick.
7' Xavi Simons (Tottenham) misses a great chance after he found some space in the box! His effort goes inches wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Newcastle.
6' A crossfield pass from Djed Spence (Tottenham) fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Newcastle.
5' Anthony Taylor has a clear sight and sees a foul from Joe Willock (Newcastle Utd). Tottenham are awarded a free kick.
3' Sven Botman (Newcastle Utd) latches onto a cross but somehow sends his close-range header high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Tottenham will have a goal kick.
3' Newcastle failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
2' The resulting corner from Anthony Elanga (Newcastle Utd) is cleared by the defence. The ball goes behind for a corner. Newcastle will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
2' Anthony Elanga (Newcastle Utd) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared. Newcastle win a corner.
1' The first half has just begun.
Tottenham will kick the game off.
Anthony Taylor was nominated as the referee for this game.
